claims.CLAIM: Federated Learning (FedAvg) achieves competitive PR-AUC against centralized upper bound under extreme banking class imbalance on European Credit Card transactions.

On the shared held-out evaluation population (56,962 transactions, 99 fraud cases) under extreme non-IID partition skew, the collaborative federated global model achieved PR-AUC 0.7788 versus 0.6113 for the Bank C silo-only model (an absolute difference of +0.1675).
Federated FedAvg matches centralized detection capability within bounded delta on simulated mobile money financial transactions (PaySim).

Under preregistered leakage-free temporal evaluation on the Elliptic Bitcoin transaction network, 2-layer GraphSAGE underperformed the 0-hop tabular MLP baseline. GraphSAGE achieved PR-AUC 0.3761 ± 0.0482 (seed 42: 0.4265), whereas the 0-hop tabular MLP baseline achieved PR-AUC 0.5778 (delta = -0.1513 vs seed 42, -0.2017 vs mean); graph neighborhood aggregation thus yielded a negative result relative to the tabular baseline without message passing.
Collaborative Federated Learning achieves robust fraud detection across simulated multi-bank partitions on real-world IEEE-CIS card transactions under strict out-of-time evaluation.

Inductive GraphSAGE with multi-hop neighborhood aggregation detects transaction-level money laundering alerts and structural typologies (Cycle and Fan-In patterns) on agent-simulated transaction networks (AMLSim) under strict chronological temporal evaluation.
